items.title: Understand
items.text: Who your users are, what they're looking for, what slows them down. Every project starts with an honest look at what exists.

items.title: Design
items.text: Architecture, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, clickable prototypes: the interface is built decision by decision, never by habit.

items.title: Refine
items.text: Testing, feedback, iteration. We polish until every screen becomes obvious — and nothing sticks out.

steps.title: Listening
steps.text: A first conversation to understand your business, your goals and your constraints. No jargon, no commitment.

steps.title: Structure
steps.text: Information architecture, user journeys, content hierarchy: the skeleton before the skin.

steps.title: Observation
steps.text: Where eyes land, where clicks hesitate. Heatmaps tell you what opinions only assume.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: High-fidelity mockups and an interactive prototype, in a visual language that feels like you.

steps.title: Handover
steps.text: Clear specifications for your developers, organised files, and a careful eye until launch.

services.title: UI/UX design, from sketch to screen

offers.title: Mockups & prototypes
offers.text: From wireframes to high-fidelity mockups, all the way to a clickable prototype you can put into real hands — before writing a single line of code.

offers.title: Interface redesign
offers.text: Modernising an ageing tool without losing the people who use it every day. We keep what works and fix what slows them down.

offers.title: Design system
offers.text: A coherent, documented component library, so your teams build fast and build right — today and two years from now.

offers.title: Responsive & mobile
offers.text: Designed for every screen from the very first line: mobile, tablet, desktop, and all the improbable widths in between.

cta.title: Does your interface deserve better?
cta.text: Tell us about your tool, your site or your idea — we'll give you our honest opinion.

work.title: Interfaces that prove themselves
work.lede: Three case studies to show the method. Yours could be next.

projects.name: Clairière
projects.challenge: A dense back office, accumulated over the years, where every piece of information took seven clicks and two memories.
projects.result: Rethought screen by screen: fewer columns, more decisions. HR teams now find what matters in two clicks.

projects.name: Comptoir
projects.challenge: A carefully curated catalogue, but a checkout that multiplied steps — and abandoned carts.
projects.result: A shorter, reassuring journey from product to payment. The cart stops being an exit door.

projects.name: Pulso
projects.challenge: A stressful first patient journey, designed for the IT department rather than the waiting room.
projects.result: Short steps, large type, human language. An app you can use even on a bad day.

work.note: Illustrative projects, shown as examples of the method.

about.title: R-X, as in X-ray
about.lede: We look beneath the surface of interfaces: what users actually do, not what we assume they do.
about.story1: R-X is an independent UI/UX design studio. Compact by choice: the people who listen to your challenges are the ones who design your screens. No middle layer, no signal loss.
about.story2: We believe in restrained interfaces. Not austere — restrained: every element earns its place by serving the user, or it goes. Demanding for us, restful for everyone else.

values.title: Restraint
values.text: Clutter is paid for in attention. We draw what serves, and remove what merely decorates.

values.title: Rigour
values.text: Every choice can be explained: a grid, a contrast, a word. Nothing is there by accident.

values.title: Transparency
values.text: Clear quotes, deadlines kept — and the truth when something gets stuck.

cta.title: Want your interface X-rayed?
cta.text: Send us a URL or a screenshot, and we'll tell you what we see.
